player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in a match of GameOfPureStrategy.
- You hold the 13 cards A-K; each can be used once.
- Each round a prize card is revealed. Play exactly ONE card by writing something that contains a bracketed token like '[Q]', '[10]', '[2]' ...
- Higher card wins the prize (plus carry-over). Ties roll prize into the pot for next round.
- Highest total after 13 rounds wins.
